statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with an outside review every second year
Annual policy review
Sanctions for any future workforce
Written, time-limited exceptions
Vendor list with breach notice terms; annual TMS SOC 2 review
Carrier identity check before the first load
Call-back before any bank detail change; 5-business-day hold
Tracking on every load; no re-brokering; pickup driver and truck named
Owner-started consultant sessions; no standing contractor admin accounts
Railroad portals only with user IDs issued to the owner
Own accounts; no shared credentials
MFA everywhere; authenticator app or hardware key for email, TMS, FMCSA
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager
Quarterly user and administrator account review
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 1 minute)
Sealed emergency access envelope with the attorney
Monthly log and bank payee review; bank change check before each ACH batch
Port-out PIN; FMCSA account recovers only to the business email
Three-level classification; decline SSI
Restricted data only in the TMS carrier file and the bank
Full-disk encryption on every device
Named-recipient sharing only; tenant default set
Twice-daily in-transit list; quarterly TMS export; monthly offline file export
Document photos into the TMS the same day
Retention schedule and recorded disposal
Five-year retention of security documentation
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
Business devices on their own network or the hotspot
AI tools only after assessment; no training on business data; no automatic payment approval
Annual awareness course covering payment fraud and carrier impersonation
Registered name and MC number in all business communications
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Breach decision with counsel; written no-harm determination sent within 30 days
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix (shipper 72 hours; Florida 30 days)
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Written backup broker agreement
Answer surety and FMCSA notices within 7 business days; attorney as backup
Monthly FMCSA record check; updates within 30 days
